text:
Zoe (Product Designer): Quick design thread: rework the on-prem 'network preflight' page. Idea: compact CIDR input on the left, detection summary on the right, inline 'what we check' help. Sketch: https://figma.com/file/xyz.
Mike (PM): Goal = fewer support tickets and clearer remediation steps. Keep language approachable.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): Important: agent only checks outbound TLS & DNS. Avoid wording that sounds like we scanned customer ports. Also prefer a re-run button and cached results for ~10m to save load.
Eve (UX Writer): Draft copies: Idle: 'Preflight will check connectivity and routes — usually <10s.' Running: 'Checking connectivity...' Success: 'All checks passed.' Fail: 'Agent couldn't establish a secure connection to <host>. Verify outbound TLS to that host and your VPC routes.' I'll make beginner/advanced variants.
Alana (Accessibility): A11y notes: status must not rely on color; include icon + visible label. Link CIDR helper via aria-describedby. Use polite live regions for status updates; ETA must be 'estimated' not a live countdown.
Zoe (Product Designer): I'll update the mock with iconography, sr-only live region, and 'Last checked 3m ago' badge + re-run. Will post new frame shortly.
Mike (PM): I'll review remediation copy and check if we can include quick links to docs.
Sanjay (Eng - Runtime): I'll add telemetry for probe durations and ensure logs obfuscate IPs.
deploy-bot: Docs updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/onprem/preflight-checks
Zoe (Product Designer): Thanks — please review when I push the frame. :thumbsup:
